title: Docking approach (LVLH)
description:
Spacecraft approach along the +V-bar corridor of the station through three hold points to soft contact, with the 200 m keep-out sphere.

Positions are station-relative LVLH metres.

variants.label: Nominal
variants.notes: Chaser decelerates from 3 km along +V-bar with dwells at three hold points; closing speed stays below 2 m/s.

variants.label: Noisy navigation
variants.notes: Chaser decelerates from 3 km along +V-bar with dwells at three hold points; closing speed stays below 2 m/s.
